exactQuestion: What is the deadline for filing BIR Form 1701?
publicAnswer:
### Short Answer
The deadline for filing BIR Form 1701, which is the annual income tax return for individuals, is on or before the fifteenth (15th) day of April of each year, covering income for the preceding taxable year.

### Controlling Authorities
This requirement is established under Section 51(C)(1) of the National Internal Revenue Code (NIRC).

### Interpretation
Section 51(C)(1) of the NIRC specifies that individuals required to file an income tax return must do so by April 15 each year. This applies to all individuals subject to income tax, ensuring that they report their income for the previous year within the stipulated timeframe.

### Practical Meaning
Taxpayers must ensure that BIR Form 1701 is submitted by the April 15 deadline to avoid penalties and interest for late filing. This deadline is crucial for compliance with tax obligations and maintaining good standing with the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR).
